gaps: No new-building permit appears in DOB data. DOB’s searchable job records for this building begin in 1990; older permits (including the original construction permit) survive only as scanned papers in DOB’s Building Information System and the Municipal Archives.
Online property records (ACRIS) for this lot start in 1971. ACRIS indexes Manhattan documents back to 1966; older deeds are on microfilm at the City Register.
No public-domain historical image confidently matched to this building in NYPL Digital Collections (only landmarks in the pilot are searched so far). Try the NYPL link under “Dig deeper”.

Businesses: office tenants come from New York State company filings, whose address records are thin before the 1990s; shops and restaurants from City records. Tenants before that (and companies that never filed this address) are not covered yet. NYPL city directories are the planned source for earlier years.
News: newspaper coverage is not gathered automatically yet. Use the newspaper links under “Dig deeper”.

sentences.text: Empire State Building stands at 350 Fifth Avenue, Manhattan.
It was built in 1929–1931, designed by Shreve, Lamb & Harmon [William Lamb], for John J. Raskob (General Motors).
An Art Deco office building, it has 102 floors and a roof height of about 1239 ft; its original use was commercial, offices.
City Planning records a major alteration in 2011.
On May 19, 1981, the Landmarks Preservation Commission designated it a New York City Interior Landmark and a New York City Individual Landmark.

New York State company filings place 196 companies’ offices here now; the longest-standing include Daxor Corporation (since 1992), K & V Realty Corp. (since 1997), Strato Trading Group, Inc. (since 1996), Chinaton International Inc. (since 1998) and 2109 First Avenue Realty Corp. (since 1998).

Earlier office tenants on file include Andrea Stuart LTD. (1998–2025), Catafago, P.C. (1999–2026), Success Travel & Tours CO., Inc. (2001–2025), Knightcrown Inc. (2002–2026) and Fine Sheer Industries, Inc. (1995–2018).

Shops and restaurants on current City records include Alidoro, AT&T Mobility Supply LLC, Chipotle Mexican Grill #3641, Chop't, Empire Diamond Corporation, Ghirardelli, Handy Candy Inc. and Linkedin 28TH Floor Coffee Bar (14 in all).
Earlier shops and restaurants include Juice Press (until 2025) and A3 Artists Agency (until 2024).
Recorded leases name ESB Observatory LLC (2011), Icbc-Ny, LLC (2007), ICBC Corporation (2004) and US Postal Service (1973) as tenants.
